sloka: किम् तव अपकृतम् राजन् वने निवसता मया ।जिहीर्षिउर् अम्भो गुर्व् अर्थम् यद् अहम् ताडितः त्वया ॥२-६३-४१॥
transliteration: kim tava apakṛtam rājan vane nivasatā mayā ।jihīrṣiur ambho gurv artham yad aham tāḍitaḥ tvayā ॥2-63-41॥

translations.english: 'O king you have struck me when I was trying to carry water to my parents. I am a forestdweller. What harm have I done to you?
